# `Browser.Visibility`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Visibility — read the document visibility state over `Ipe.Ffi.Js`
ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` requests the state (`state` one-shot or a
continuous `watch`), and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the reply — a decoded
`State` or a typed unavailability. Both cross the same seal codec and
fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses
`js-port:visibility` (import-derived, keyed on the canonical
`Ipe.Browser.Visibility` path prefix via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`,
alias-immune); only the top-level app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant
it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Visibility.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `state` returns a `Task Error State`
    via the correlated port→Task bridge; `watch` is `Cmd`-shaped, and `changes`
    is the inbound subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed
    `Result Error State`. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability
    becomes a typed `Err`, never a silently dropped variant.

## `State`

The document visibility state.

  * `Visible` — the document is at least partially visible (the page is in the
    foreground tab).
  * `Hidden` — the document is not visible (backgrounded, minimised, or on an
    inactive tab).

## `state`

```ipe
state : Task Error State
```

`state` — read the current document visibility state ONCE, as a
`Task Error State`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The reply — a `State` or a
typed unavailability — resolves the `Task` directly; no companion subscription
is needed.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:visibility`; the app must grant it
with `accepts = [ JsPort Visibility ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a CONTINUOUS visibility stream; each `visibilitychange`
event delivers a fresh reading on the `changes` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `changes`

```ipe
changes : (Result Error State -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`changes toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error State` — a `Reading` becomes `Ok`, an unavailability a typed `Err`.
